MetricFormula / basisCalculated resultInterpretation
Precision = TP/(TP+FP) · Recall = TP/(TP+FN) · F1 = 2×Precision×Recall/(Precision+Recall) · FPR = FP/(FP+TN) · FNR = FN/(FN+TP). Metrics requiring a zero denominator show N/A. Accuracy = (TP+TN)/(TP+FP+FN+TN). Throughput and parsing success are calculated from your measured inputs. CPU and memory are manually entered measurements.
